result_revision: uncommitted; user owns staging, commits and pushes
scope: Current-machine mutual TLS certificate authentication and bounded owned sessions, exact application sequencing, expiry/revocation/rates/reconnect fencing, separate process fixtures, CPU/sanitizers and protected dependency/package closure.

retained_M02a_archive_review.scope: M02a exact upstream dependency archive/source/license review, not final build qualification

dependency.owner_target: EngineCore private TLS transport; no public Mbed TLS or PSA types

vendored_inputs.pin: Bundled in the verified official release archive
Bundled in the verified official release archive; generated files and nested framework included

dependency.verification: Official release/API digest and tag commit reviewed 2026-10-18. LTS maintenance ends March2029. Official full release archive includes generated files and pinned submodules; GitHub automatic source archives are not equivalent.
dependency.notes: Apache-2.0 option selected from Mbed TLS/TF-PSA dual Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later offer; retain complete license text and embedded permissive notices. Exact regular files are verified before configure and by source closure; 147 symlinks solely under unused PQC test/example directories are intentionally not materialized. No upstream source changes, test/example targets, transitive downloads, package fallback, shared crypto libraries or public TLS types. Config uses fixed16384-byte record buffers; runtime restricts TLS1.3, authenticated server certificates, P256 and AES128GCM/SHA256. No tickets/resumption/early data; account auth belongs to M02b. TCP head-of-line behavior is an explicit provisional local foundation limit.

notes: Root release notes claim TF-PSA1.2.0; bundled CMake says1.1.1; exact bundled commit and full archive authoritative.
Upstream generated files retained; no source patch or target auto-download.
All omitted symlinks are unused PQC examples/tests. All regular source bytes verified on every configure.
Runtime restricts TLS1.3, P256, ECDSA/SHA256, AES128GCM/SHA256; compile config limits record payload16384 and maxintermediateCA4.
IntermediateCA verification limit is not a preparse allocation count. TLS1.3 cert list <65536; assembled handshake additionally limited by fixed input buffer.
PQC disabled in pinned default crypto config.

public_credential_fixture_review.scope: Public fixture syntax, dates, exact DER fingerprints, key pairing and independent OpenSSL client-purpose expectations; engine rejection tests remain separate.
development_findings: OpenSSL sslclient purpose permits keyAgreement-only usage; TLS 1.3 and the Shark client profile require digitalSignature. Do not conflate generic purpose verification with the negotiated protocol profile.

sdk_free_runtime.scope: fresh installed Server and EnTT/GLM and all eight locked MbedTLS notices in retained SDK-free pinned Ubuntu runtime userspace; isolated network; shared WSL kernel; writable rootfs

commands.name: tls-sanitizer-compilation
command:
import hashlib, json, shlex
from pathlib import Path
rows = []
for build in (Path('/work/build-05a-final/server-asan-ubsan'),
              Path('/work/build-05a-final-client/linux-asan-ubsan')):
    path = build / 'compile_commands.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text())
    c_units = [entry for entry in entries if Path(entry['file']).suffix == '.c']
    assert c_units, f'Missing TLS C compiler units: {build}'
    for entry in c_units:
        assert '/_deps/mbedtls-src/' in entry['file'], entry['file']
        arguments = entry.get('arguments') or shlex.split(entry['command'])
        assert Path(arguments[0]).name == 'clang-18', arguments[0]
        assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in arguments, entry['file']
        assert '-fno-omit-frame-pointer' in arguments, entry['file']
    rows.append({'build': str(build), 'status': 'PASS',
                 'tls_c_translation_units': len(c_units),
                 'compiler': 'clang-18', 'sanitizers': ['address', 'undefined'],
                 'compile_commands_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))

runtime_audit.gcc_base_scope: Ubuntu gcc-14-base contains only directories and documentation, not compiler executables; retained runtime inventory is compared separately.

resolved_development_findings: Outer kind5 became a valid session request; the independent unknown-kind wire negative now uses7 and both new kinds have bounds coverage.
Reply codec now rejects ready=true with sequence0, alongside inactive-ready and inactive-sequence0, using independently mutated decode fixtures.
Credential-negative process scenarios require server net.tls.handshake or net.tls.client-profile evidence; deadlines, connection failures and clean EOF cannot count as authentication rejection.
limits: Explicit trusted local certificate enrollment, immutable ownership and in-memory revocation; durable provisioning and identity storage remain M03.
Session controls are Login, SetReady, Heartbeat and Logout. No movement/combat/inventory, administrative or authoring authority is granted.
Only IPv4 loopback TLS1.3; shipped bootstrap executables expose no player listener, credential defaults or test authentication bypass.
No replicated entities, interest selection, private-field replication or convergence qualification; M02c/M02d/M02e remain required.
One owner thread and caller-driven polling/expiry; global private crypto mutex, bounded capacities and steps are not hard CPU-time or total RSS guarantees.
Windows development tools remain installed; SDK-free Server runs in retained WSL userspace sharing this PC/kernel. No independent-machine, WAN or MMO capacity claim.
Full REQ-M02 remains NOT_RUN until M02c through M02e complete.
